subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 447 (TRF(CW)-19). AF-POST (affinity postulation) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: APL-DT (application dictates), TR (transformation) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From APL-DT: HI-P (high purpose). From HI-P: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From SPT-DY: APL-DT-2 (application dictates, a second APL-DT label). From TR: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). From UNF-PI: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From RT-INT-TR: REL-APC (relevant application). From VT-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism).
